question: E79 Amendment 2: job 51161 filed 'passes all three' for A, but its three rules never read do-nothing, the reference GOALS.md excludes as an answer. Does A's own-mask read beat do-nothing, or does the read credit any forward near FT? And how much of A's fall comes from A's masks with nothing placed?
rules: experiments/qwen_masked_read/rules_amend2.py; run against the zero and negative denominator, NaN, ties on the 3b band and on s = 0.5 and 0.9 in tests/test_qwen_masked_read.py before filing

states.W0, A: As job 51161: E76's bf16 offsets from qwen_masked_teacher/results/large/, Gamma on the state's own forward; read on M only, in this job's control stage, so every number in a rule is this job's
states.N: Do-nothing. Weights FT = W0 + dW (qwen_teacher.do_nothing, dW = E40 step 10 as bf16, cast to fp32 and added per site), components unmoved, offsets zero, Gamma on FT's forward. The masked forward is ((x V) * (m - d)) U + d (x (W0 + dW)^T), so Delta = Delta_0 + dW
states.Z: A's masks with nothing placed. W0's weights and components, offsets zero, A's own g, computed under A's offsets and then the offsets reset. With W0 masks and no offsets (1.334), W0 masks and A's offsets (1.127), A's masks and A's offsets (0.078), it completes the square

rows: M and W as job 51161: E76's 8 reading rows (maths 0-7), and FineWeb rows 32-39, 256 tokens
masks: g in bf16; m = g + (1 - g) u, d ~ U(0, 1), a fresh generator per row set at draw d1 (seed 76200), so Z's masks are the very masks of A's read; W0 also at d2 (seed 79200), for the band; all 196 sites masked; readings in full fp32

own.what: forward KL(FT clean || state masked), and reverse, top-token agreement, entropy

expected.N: measured; near A's unless the placement matters
expected.Z: measured; near A's if masks alone

own.blind_to: forward rewards softness; which subcomponents move

expected.N: equal to N's own within N's clean
expected.Z: measured; W0's clean against W0's forward under A's masks

self.blind_to: how far the state's clean is from FT

g.what: Sigma-g per position over all 196 sites and all columns, and the count of g > 0.5 per position, mean over rows and positions

control.Z_W0g: Z's path given W0's g reads this job's W0 number on M, d1, within 1e-3: the same forward, with A's offsets loaded and reset just before
control.N_clean: N's clean forward KL to FT clean on M under 1e-4: the same weights, two forwards in one precision, the matrices swapped against change_hooks
control.what: First and alone, in order W0, A, Z's path, N's clean: W0 and A own on M at d1 reproduce job 51161's within 1e-3 (results/amend1.json, reads.<state>.M.d1). Any miss, NaN included: results/stopped_amend2.json and exit 1

rule.on: Row set M, forward KL(FT clean || state masked), draw d1, all positions, every number read in this job
rule.band: b = W0's difference between d1 and d2 on the forward KL on M, as Amendment 1; job 51161 read 0.0042269
rule.do_nothing: N own - A own > 3 b: 'A beats do-nothing'; < -3 b: 'do-nothing beats A'; otherwise 'same'. NaN anywhere: 'unread'. The size is reported as read
rule.masks_alone: s = (W0 own - Z) / (W0 own - A own). s >= 0.9: 'masks alone'; s <= 0.5: 'needs the offsets'; between: 'mixed'. A zero or negative denominator: 'no call', with or without Z. Any other NaN: 'unread'. s under 0 and over 1 take the near label and s is reported as read. The bands 0.5 and 0.9 are chosen here, not sourced: they are labels on a share reported as read, and nothing filed turns on the middle
rule.ties: Numbers compared rounded to 9 places. Exactly 3 b either way is 'same'; s exactly 0.9 is 'masks alone', exactly 0.5 'needs the offsets'
rule.W: Reported as read, no rule: its room is small (W0 clean 0.040, own 0.131; job 51161)

what_each_result_does.can see a placement: 'A beats do-nothing' and 'needs the offsets' or 'mixed': the own-mask read can see a placement; A stays a candidate map, for the user to weigh against masks in the loss (ask 24)
what_each_result_does.credits any forward near FT: 'same' or 'do-nothing beats A', whatever the share: the own-mask read credits any forward near FT, so it is not a D1 test and says nothing for A over B; the clean table stands alone, and what A has shown is only clean agreement at 0.52 of the update's squared size
what_each_result_does.reported as read: 'A beats do-nothing' with 'masks alone' or 'no call': the plan names no result, reported as read
what_each_result_does.after: Either way the E79 write-up follows and the next step goes to the user; E79 has no amendments left

blind_to: Which subcomponents move (not read); a single update, seed and draw; 16 rows. N's Delta opens with d, so N is Delta's best case, as the Terms' do-nothing is
not_run: Other seeds or draws for N and Z; A and W0 on W in this job (job 51161's stand as references there); a do-nothing with Delta off, as E68 read it; N or Z under W0's frozen masks
